title: Help with parameters/stats (HP, MP, all that)

posts.author: pochijp
posts.body:
I don't know if this is going to be complicated to explain but I'll try! And I'm sorry if whatever I say comes out as ignorance.
So, I consider that RPG Maker parameters (or stats, for this matter), especially the HP, are veeery high to my likeness. Like at lvl 15 or so a character can end up having even 2000+ HP and I tried to reduce said number. Not because it messes up with gameplay but just because I don't want my characters having high numbers like that.
So, for example, I want the average lvl 1 character to have 50 HP and the max HP a character at lvl 99 can get is 5000. So my main character, Pochi, who has low HP stats, starts with 55HP, and at level 20 or so he is 646HP, and at level 25 he has 801HP and so on, with his level 99 HP being something like 2900 I think.
So I tried the character and of course his HP was super low in comparison to the damage he receives. One attack can literally almost kill him, with basic enemies hitting 40pts. Ofc I realized I had to also modify the other stats so I did.
For the other stats (ATK, DEF, AGL...) I wanted the lvl 1 characters to start with either 1 to 10 points depending on their class. Pochi, who's a mage, starts with 4pts, Cornelio, who's a thief, starts with 6pts, and Kira, who's a... idk but she hits hard, starts with 10pts. The max ATQ a character can get a lvl 99 naturally (without equipment) is 200, so at lvl 99 Pochi has like 120 ATK, cornelio has 150 ATK, and Kira has 175 ATK. Did the same with other stats: Defense, Magic attack, Agility and so on. The problem is that now NOBODY has enough strength to attack properly. No one makes damage because, well, I messed up and I don't know how to fix it without getting back to the status quo.
I just want the stats to work the way I said:
· Average LVL 1 minimum HP is 50 HP and LVL99 max. HP is 5000 HP.
· Average LVL 1 minimum MP is 30 MP and LVL99 max. MP is 500 MP.
· LVL 1 minimum attack, defense, magic attack, magic defense, agility and luck is from 1pts to 10pts (which depends on the character) and LVL99 max. stats is 200.
Is there a way I can do this? I hope my explanation wasn't messy.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
yes - but only if you calculate correct on every connected part, and you completely overlooked one impotant part:
the damage formula
the damage formula of your skills is what transloates your parameter values into damage.
and the damage per turn multiplied with the average turn number (or how long you want your battles to last) has to be around the average enemy HP.
if you include that in your calculations and tests, then you can make the rest work as well.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Have you done some tutorials for VX Ace? Or gone through the instructions? Most tutorials show the class information as one of the first things.
You go to the Classes tab and click into the Parameter Curves. You can set what you want it to be at level 1, then at level 99, then Generate the Curve in between.

tons
of threads about how to balance your game. One super simple way is make them have the same values. The enemies you fight at level 1 have the same parameters as your classes at level 1.
Start with that and if the battles are too long or too short, change from there.
